text.formatted: The jelly can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so.
text.plain: The jelly can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so.

text.formatted: The jelly can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.
text.plain: The jelly can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

text.formatted: _Melee Attack Roll:_ +4, reach 5 ft. _Hit:_ 12 (3d6 + 2) Acid damage.
text.plain: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 12 (3d6 + 2) Acid damage.

text.formatted: _Trigger:_ While the jelly is Large or Medium and has 10+ Hit Points, it becomes Bloodied or is subjected to Lightning or Slashing damage. _Response:_ The jelly splits into two new **Ochre Jellies**. Each new jelly is one size smaller than the original jelly and acts on its Initiative. The original jelly's Hit Points are divided evenly between the new jellies (round down).
